common:generalComment.#text: 本数据集描述了＜1kV低压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: 聚丙烯（Polypropylene，简称PP）是一种半结晶热塑性塑料，具有较高的抗冲击性、良好的机械性能，并可耐受多种有机溶剂及酸碱腐蚀。其工业用途广泛，包括包装材料、标签和纺织品。聚丙烯在一定温度范围内熔融，因此通常以差示扫描量热曲线的峰值温度确定熔点。完全等规聚丙烯的熔点为171℃；商业等规聚丙烯的熔点通常为160–166℃，具体取决于无规立构组分含量和结晶度；结晶度为30%的间规聚丙烯熔点为130℃。

Polypropylene (PP) is a semi-crystalline thermoplastic with relatively high impact resistance, robust mechanical properties, and resistance to many organic solvents, acids and alkalis. It is widely used in industry, including in packaging materials, labels and textiles. Polypropylene melts over a temperature range, so its melting point is commonly determined from the peak temperature of a differential scanning calorimetry curve. Perfectly isotactic polypropylene has a melting point of 171 °C. Commercial isotactic polypropylene generally melts at 160–166 °C, depending on its atactic fraction and crystallinity. Syndiotactic polypropylene with 30% crystallinity has a melting point of 130 °C.

common:generalComment.#text: Tap water refers to water that has been processed for safety and compliance with drinking water standards and is commonly supplied to households and industries via plumbing systems. It is treated to remove contaminants and pathogens, typically involving processes such as filtration, sedimentation, and disinfection. This water is ready for direct consumption or use in various applications 'to consumer' and 'at plant'. The specific treatment methods and quality can vary depending on the location and local water source.

common:generalComment.#text: Cotton is a seed-hair fibre of several species of plants of the genus Gossypium, belonging to the hibiscus, or mallow, family (Malvaceae). It is one of the world's leading agricultural crops, plentiful and economically produced. Cotton is a soft, fluffy staple fiber that grows in a boll, or protective case, around the seeds of the cotton plants. It is a staple textile of the fashion industry and the most widely produced natural fiber on the planet.
棉花是属于木槿或锦葵科（锦葵属）的棉属植物中多个品种的籽毛纤维。它是世界主要农作物之一，产量丰富且经济实惠。棉花是一种柔软、蓬松的短纤维，生长在棉铃或棉花种子周围的保护壳中。它是时装业的主要纺织品，也是地球上生产最广泛的天然纤维。

common:generalComment.#text: Hydraulic fluid's main function in hydraulic systems is to transmit power from one part of a system to another. It converts mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure, which is uniformly distributed throughout the fluid. The pressure can move pistons or cylinders, which in turn move other parts of the system. Hydraulic fluid is a non-compressible, engineered medium that provides lubrication and heat and power transfer properties. It is composed of a base oil, which can be mineral or synthetic, along with various performance-enhancing additives.
液压流体在液压系统中的主要功能是将动力从系统的一个部分传递到另一个部分。它将机械能转化为液压，液压均匀分布在整个流体中。压力可以移动活塞或气缸，进而移动系统的其他部分。液压流体是一种不可压缩的工程介质，具有润滑、传热和动力传递特性。它由矿物油或合成基础油以及各种性能增强添加剂组成。

common:generalComment.#text: Wood waste is a significant component of municipal solid waste (MSW), accounting for 20-30% of all waste globally. It comes from various sources including furniture, durable goods, wood packaging, and miscellaneous products. Less than a third of this waste is recycled. Despite this, wood waste is a valuable resource, contributing to natural resource conservation, energy efficiency, industrial economics, reforestation, job creation, and climate change mitigation.
木材垃圾是城市固体废物的重要组成部分，占全球所有垃圾的20-30%。它来自各种来源，包括家具、耐用品、木包装和杂项产品。这些废物中只有不到三分之一被回收利用。尽管如此，木材废料还是一种宝贵的资源，有助于自然资源保护、能源效率、工业经济、重新造林、创造就业机会和缓解气候变化。

白刚玉；白色熔融氧化铝；人造刚玉

common:generalComment.#text: White Fused Alumina, a processed and high-purity form of aluminum oxide, is manufactured through the fusion of calcined alumina in electric arc furnaces at high temperatures, followed by a cooling process. It is characterized by its high hardness and chemical inertness, making it suitable for refractories and abrasives. The product is compliant with industry standards, and is utilized predominantly in surface finishing, grinding, and cutting applications. The information further details the production route from bauxite, the educt name 'alumina', and its distribution either to consumers or direct availability at the production plant.
白色熔融氧化铝是一种经过处理且纯度较高的氧化铝形式，通过在电弧炉中对煅烧氧化铝进行高温熔融之后的冷却过程而制成。其具有高硬度和化学惰性的特点，适用于耐火材料和磨料。产品符合行业标准，并主要用于表面精加工、研磨和切割应用。信息进一步详述了从铝土矿到氧化铝（产品流的原材料名称）的生产路线，以及产品向消费者的分配或在生产工厂的直接可用性。

common:synonyms.#text: Polyurethane foam; Flexible polyurethane foam; FPF
聚氨酯泡沫；软质聚氨酯泡沫；软质聚氨酯泡沫（FPF）

common:generalComment.#text: Polyfoam is the abbreviated term for polyurethane foam, sometimes called flexible polyurethane foam (FPF), per the Polyurethane Foam Association (PFA). It has been around since 1937 and has become quite popular for its ability to provide cushioning. It is a rigid, semirigid, or rubbery foam composed of minute bubbles of air or carbon dioxide embedded in a polymer matrix, often polyurethane. It is used in mattresses, padding, insulation, etc. Polyurethane foam, also known as polyfoam, is one of the most used bedding materials.
Polyfoam 是聚氨酯泡沫塑料的缩写，聚氨酯泡沫塑料协会（PFA）称其为软质聚氨酯泡沫塑料（FPF）。它从 1937 年开始出现，因其缓冲能力而颇受欢迎。它是一种硬质、半硬质或橡胶泡沫，由嵌入聚合物基质（通常是聚氨酯）中的微小气泡或二氧化碳组成。它可用于床垫、衬垫、隔热材料等。聚氨酯泡沫又称聚泡沫塑料，是最常用的床上用品材料之一。

common:generalComment.#text: 本数据集描述了1-35kV中压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of 1-35kV medium voltage alternating current (MVAC) electricity from the point of generation, through transmission, to the final supply to the consumers who use the electricity. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: A paper bag is a bag made of paper, usually kraft paper. They can be made either with virgin or recycled fibres. Paper bags are commonly used as shopping carrier bags and for packaging of some consumer goods. They are a type of packaging deemed less harmful than plastic bags. They are reusable, biodegradable and recyclable. Paper bags come in different shapes and sizes, with two basic types: open mouth and valve.
纸袋是由纸制成的袋子，通常是牛皮纸。它们可以由原生纤维或回收纤维制成。纸袋通常用作购物手提袋和包装一些消费品。它们被认为是比塑料袋更不有害的包装类型。它们是可重复使用的，可生物降解的和可回收的。纸袋有不同的形状和大小，有两种基本类型：开口和阀门。

common:generalComment.#text: Asphalt is a sticky, black, and highly viscous liquid or semi-solid form of petroleum. It is used primarily for road construction, where it is mixed with aggregate particles to create asphalt concrete. Its processing level includes refinement from crude oil, and it is subject to quality and compliance standards for construction materials. Asphalt usage spans from road paving to waterproofing applications. It is generally available as a production mix at an asphalt plant, and as a component in construction mixes to the consumer.
沥青是一种粘稠、黑色、高粘度的液态或半固态石油产品。主要用于道路建设，与骨料混合后制成沥青混凝土。其加工水平包括从原油中精炼，并且它要符合建筑材料的质量和合规标准。沥青的使用范围从铺路到防水应用都有。它通常作为生产混合物在沥青厂可得，以及作为建筑混合材料的组成部分提供给消费者。

bituminous waterproofing membrane; bituminous roofing felt; roll roofing

common:generalComment.#text: Bitumen (asphalt or coal-tar pitch) is a material made up of organic liquids that are highly sticky, viscous, and waterproof. It is sometimes used to construct roofs, in the form of roofing felt or roll roofing products. Bitumen primer penetrates deeply, dries quickly and provides a secure fixation of waterproofing materials. Bitumen latex waterproofing emulsion is a compound of two mutually insoluble liquids (bitumen and water). Bitumen-based liquid membrane and bitumen-based roll membrane materials are used for roof insulation.
沥青（柏油或煤焦油）是由高度粘稠、防水的有机液体组成的材料。有时用于建造屋顶，形式为屋顶毡或卷材屋顶产品。沥青底漆深入渗透，快速干燥，并提供了防水材料的牢固固定。沥青乳胶防水乳液是两种互不溶解的液体（沥青和水）的复合物。沥青基液态膜和沥青基卷材膜材料用于屋顶绝缘。

common:generalComment.#text: Calcined coke is a high purity carbon material produced by heating green petroleum coke to drive off moisture, volatile matter, and impurities and to increase its electrical conductivity. It is used primarily in the production of anodes for aluminium smelting, as well as in graphite electrodes for electric arc furnaces and in carbon raisers in steel and foundry industries. The production route typically involves delayed coking, and the product is available to consumers and at plant level.
煅烧焦炭是一种高纯度碳材料，通过加热石油焦来驱除水分、挥发分和杂质，并提高其电导率而制成。它主要用于铝冶炼阳极的生产，以及电弧炉用石墨电极和钢铁及铸造行业中的碳升高剂。生产路线通常涉及延迟焦化过程，产品可供消费者使用，也可在工厂级别获取。

No particular particle-size distribution, chemical composition, stack height or LCIA characterization factor is assigned by this Flow definition. (2021), DOI 10.13671/j.hjkxxb.2021.0276, reports 0.01689 kg/t of particulate-matter emissions from clinker preheating and calcination after dust collection, without reporting particle size. This is a source-specific application example, not the amount per kilogram of this Flow or a requirement that all uses represent the same treatment technology. Actual emissions, controls and source evidence belong to the corresponding Process exchange; characterization coverage is assessed for the exact Flow and the selected LCIA method.

common:synonyms.#text: refractory brick; fire brick; heat-resistant brick; high-temperature brick; kiln brick; furnace brick

common:generalComment.#text: Refractory bricks are materials capable of maintaining structural and performance stability under high-temperature conditions. They are commonly used as linings in high-temperature industrial equipment such as kilns, furnaces, and boilers. Made primarily from high-alumina, silica, or magnesia-based materials, refractory bricks are manufactured through high-temperature firing. They are characterized by high heat resistance, thermal shock resistance, and strong chemical stability, making them widely used in industries such as metallurgy, construction materials, and chemicals.
耐火砖是一种能够在高温环境下保持结构和性能稳定的材料，通常用于高温工业设备如窑炉、熔炉和锅炉内衬。其主要原材料包括高铝矿物、硅质材料和镁质材料，通过高温烧制而成。耐火砖具有高耐热性、抗热震性以及较强的化学稳定性，在冶金、建材、化工等行业中广泛应用。

common:generalComment.#text: Alumina, also known as the oxide of aluminum, occurs both in pure form as corundum and in hydrated forms (as in bauxite). It is widely used in a variety of industrial abrasive materials due to its superior hardness and strength. Alumina can also be used as a coating to protect against abrasion and in refractory products due to its high melting point. In most industrial applications, corundum has been replaced by synthetic materials such as alumina, an aluminum oxide made from bauxite.
氧化铝又称铝的氧化物，以刚玉和水合形式（如铝土矿）存在。由于其硬度和强度极高，氧化铝被广泛用于各种工业研磨材料。氧化铝还可用作涂层以防止磨损，并因其熔点高而用于耐火产品。在大多数工业应用中，刚玉已被氧化铝等合成材料所取代，氧化铝是从铝土矿中提取的一种氧化铝。

common:synonyms.#text: compressed air; air reduced in volume and held under pressure
压缩空气；经压缩并在压力下储存的空气

common:generalComment.#text: Compressed air is air kept under a pressure that is greater than atmospheric pressure. It is an important medium for transfer of energy in industrial processes, and is used for power tools such as air hammers, drills, wrenches, and others. It is also used to atomize paint, to operate air cylinders for automation. Compressed air acts as an energy source for a variety of tools and machinery, and it is often an important part of many production processes.
压缩空气是指压力大于大气压力的空气。它是工业生产过程中传递能量的重要介质，可用于气锤、电钻、扳手等电动工具。它还用于雾化油漆、操作自动化气缸。压缩空气是各种工具和机械的能源，通常是许多生产流程的重要组成部分。

rock wool; stone wool; mineral-wool insulation

common:generalComment.#text: Rock wool insulation provides thermal and sound insulation and can be used as a firestop between floors. It is made from natural, sustainable material and typically contains up to 75 percent recycled content. Rock wool is essentially basalt lava rock and chalk, heated to high temperatures and then spun into fine fibers. It is commonly used in hydroponics because it is pH neutral. Stone wool is a furnace product of molten rock at a temperature of about 1600 °C.
岩棉绝缘材料提供热量和声音的隔绝，并可以在楼层之间用作防火隔断。它由天然、可持续的材料制成，通常包含高达75%的再生内容。岩棉本质上是玄武岩熔岩和白垩，加热到高温然后纺成细纤维。它在水培中常用，因为它的pH值是中性的。石棉是熔岩在大约1600°C的温度下的炉产品。

common:synonyms.#text: mineral oil; white mineral oil; liquid paraffin; paraffinum liquidum
矿物油；白矿油；液体石蜡

common:generalComment.#text: Mineral oil is a colorless, transparent, oily liquid derived from crude petroleum oil. It is utilized for various purposes including treating dry skin, constipation, eczema, cradle cap, and facilitating bowel movements. Mineral oil is also a by-product from the refining of crude oil and the manufacturing of gasoline and petroleum products. It is odorless and used in cosmetics, science labs, industrial settings, and more. Despite its industrial origins, it has applications in the kitchen and is a refined petroleum oil used as a laxative.
矿物油是一种由原油衍生而来的无色透明油状液体。它用于各种目的，包括治疗皮肤干燥、便秘、湿疹、乳痂和促进排便。矿物油也是原油精炼以及汽油和石油产品制造的副产品。它无味，用于化妆品、科学实验室、工业环境等。尽管它起源于工业，但它在厨房中也有应用，是一种用作泻药的精炼石油。

common:generalComment.#text: A rivet is a mechanical fastener that consists of a smooth cylindrical shaft with a head on one end. Upon installation, the tail is deformed to hold the rivet in place, resulting in a permanent fixing. Rivets are commonly used in aircraft, bridges, structures, and various manufacturing industries. Their technical aspects include material composition, diameter, length, head type, and mechanical properties. They may comply with specific industry standards and be subject to quality control measures. Usage information often indicates which materials or structures they are intended to join. There is no specific ‘production route’ as rivets can be made from various metals or non-metallic materials depending on their application, and there is no single ‘educt name’ or production mix associated with rivets. They are available in a wide variety of sizes and materials for different uses, either to consumer or at plant.

铆钉是一种机械紧固件，它包括一个平滑的圆柱形轴和一个端部的头。安装时，尾部变形以保持铆钉到位，从而形成永久性固定。铆钉通常用于飞机、桥梁、结构和各种制造行业。其技术方面包括材料成分、直径、长度、头部类型和机械属性。它们可能符合特定行业标准，并接受质量控制措施。使用信息通常指出它们打算连接哪些材料或结构。由于铆钉可以根据其应用从不同的金属或非金属材料制成，因此没有特定的‘生产路线’，也没有与铆钉相关联的单一‘原料名称’或生产混合物。它们以多种尺寸和材料可供不同用途使用，无论是向消费者还是在工厂。

common:generalComment.#text: Deionised water is water that has had its ions removed. It is produced through a process that filters out minerals and ions such as calcium, sodium, iron, copper, chloride, and bromide. It has no set standard compliance but is often produced to meet specific quality criteria required for certain industrial or laboratory processes. Deionised water is typically used in applications where the presence of ions may interfere with machinery, experiments, or manufacturing processes, such as in cooling applications, laboratory tests, or electronics manufacturing. The production route involves ion exchange, reverse osmosis, or distillation. The product may be supplied as part of a production or consumption mix and is available at the production plant or to the consumer.
去离子水是通过去除了其离子的水。它通过过滤掉矿物质及离子如钙、钠、铁、铜、氯化物和溴化物的过程产生。它没有设定的标准遵从性，但通常生产出来以满足某些工业或实验室过程所需的特定质量标准。去离子水通常应用于离子存在可能干扰机械、实验或制造过程的地方，例如在冷却应用、实验室测试或电子制造中。其生产路线包括离子交换、反渗透或蒸馏。该产品可能作为生产或消费混合物供应，且可在生产工厂或消费者那里获得。

It is applied to a charged surface, creating a thicker coating in one application more than a single coat of paint.

common:generalComment.#text: Sawdust is a byproduct of the lumber industry, created when wood is cut or milled into lumber. It comprises tiny wood particles ranging from fine dust to small chips. Commonly used as a fuel source, sawdust can also serve as a soil amendment. It is particularly beneficial for low-pH crops like blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries, acting as an inexpensive mulch option. Sawdust's powdery texture and light brown or gray color result from the sawing, sanding, or grinding of wood during processing.

common:generalComment.#text: Polypropylene (PP) is a widely used, recyclable thermoplastic polymer. It is the most commonly used plastic packaging material in the United States due to its melting point and strength. However, PP products degrade slowly in landfills, taking up to 20-30 years to degrade completely. It is used in a range of applications and products, from food packaging to automotive parts, and is known for its strength, durability, and resistance to chemicals and moisture.

common:generalComment.#text: Phosphating is a conversion coating applied to steel or iron components, mostly used as a pretreatment method for corrosion protection. The process involves immersing a component in a dilute solution, converting the surface of the metal into a layer of microscopic phosphate crystals. A layer of phosphate coating typically includes iron, zinc or manganese crystals. Phosphating is a surface preparation method for ferrous metals before coating or painting. It increases corrosion prevention and also helps improve anti-friction properties.
磷化是一种应用于钢或铁部件的转化涂层，主要用作防腐保护的预处理方法。该过程涉及将部件浸入稀溶液中，将金属表面转化为一层微观磷酸盐晶体。磷酸盐涂层通常包括铁、锌或锰晶体。磷化是铁质金属涂层或涂漆前的表面准备方法。它增加了防腐能力，也有助于提高抗摩擦性能。

common:generalComment.#text: Powder coating is a type of coating that is applied as a free-flowing, dry powder. It is typically applied electrostatically and then cured under heat or with ultraviolet light. It is a multi-step surface finishing process suitable for metal and non-metal substrates. The method includes a preparation, application, and curing stage. Powder coating is a mixture of polymer resin, flow modifiers, leveling agents, and other additives. After it has been heated and cured, powder coating produces tough finishes able to withstand extreme weather conditions while resisting fading and cracking.
粉末涂料是一种以自由流动的干粉形式施加的涂料。它通常通过静电方式施加，然后在热量或紫外线下固化。这是一种适用于金属和非金属基材的多步骤表面处理过程。该方法包括准备、应用和固化阶段。粉末涂料是聚合物树脂、流动改性剂、流平剂和其他添加剂的混合物。经过加热和固化后，粉末涂料能产生能够抵抗极端天气条件的坚韧表面，同时抵抗褪色和开裂。

common:generalComment.#text: Foamed plastic is a synthetic resin converted into a spongelike mass with a closed-cell or open-cell structure, which may be flexible or rigid. It is used for a variety of products including cushioning materials, air filters, furniture, toys, thermal insulation, sponges, plastic boats, panels for buildings, and even lightweight beams. Foamed plastics take all kinds of resin as the raw material and are heated until foams appear. They are a new type with the properties of lightweight, heat preservation, sound absorption, and quakeproof.
发泡塑料是一种合成树脂，转化为具有闭孔或开孔结构的海绵状质地，可能是柔软或硬质的。它被用于各种产品，包括缓冲材料、空气过滤器、家具、玩具、热绝缘材料、海绵、塑料船、建筑面板，甚至轻质梁。发泡塑料以各种树脂为原料，加热至出现泡沫。它们是一种新型材料，具有轻质、保温、吸音和抗震的特性。

common:generalComment.#text: Particle board, also known as chipboard or low-density fiberboard, is an engineered wood product manufactured from wood chips and a synthetic resin or other suitable binder. It is often confused with oriented strand board. It is a waste wood product made by binding wood chips, sawdust, or sawmill shavings with a synthetic resin or some other binder. Urea Formaldehyde is commonly used as a glue for binding wooden chips. It is a building material that is manufactured from lumber scraps such as wood shavings, wood chips, sawdust, and other by-products from lumber mill operations.
颗粒板，也被称为刨花板或低密度纤维板，是一种由木片和合成树脂或其他适当的粘合剂制成的工程木材产品。它经常被误认为是定向刨花板。它是一种由木片、锯末或锯木厂削片与合成树脂或其他粘合剂结合制成的废弃木材产品。尿素甲醛常被用作粘合木片的胶水。它是一种由木屑、木片、锯末和其他伐木厂副产品制成的建筑材料。

Welding steel pipe is a method for joining two pipes together using techniques such as MIG welding and TIG welding. Welded pipe is a tubular product made out of flat plates, known as skelp, that are formed, bent, and prepared for welding. The most popular process for large diameter pipe uses a longitudinal seam weld. Welding steel pipes is a multi-million dollar industry, growing every day to cater to the endless demand for the welded tubings. The pipe can be rotated around the x-axis or y-axis while the welder remains stationary.
焊接钢管是一种使用MIG焊接和TIG焊接等技术将两根管子连接在一起的方法。焊接管是由平板制成的管状产品，这些平板被称为剥离板，它们被成型、弯曲并准备好进行焊接。大直径管最常用的工艺是纵向接缝焊。焊接钢管是一个价值数百万美元的行业，每天都在增长，以满足对焊接管材的无尽需求。在焊工保持静止的情况下，可以围绕x轴或y轴旋转管道。

cutting fluid; metalworking fluid; cutting coolant and lubricant

common:generalComment.#text: Cutting fluid is a type of coolant and lubricant designed specifically for metalworking processes, such as machining and stamping. It includes oils, oil-water emulsions, pastes, gels, aerosols, and air or other gases. It is used in the metalworking process like cutting, drilling, milling, turning to reduce the heat produced due to the deformation and machining process to lubricate for reducing friction and wear and tear on the workpiece. These fluids are typically produced by a simple process of mixing water and mineral oils, fatty oils, and vegetable oils, with an emulsifier.
切削液是一种专为金属加工过程（如机械加工和冲压）设计的冷却剂和润滑剂。它包括油、油水乳化液、膏、凝胶、气雾剂以及空气或其他气体。在金属加工过程中，如切削、钻孔、铣削、车削等，使用切削液可以减少由于变形和机械加工过程产生的热量，润滑以减少摩擦和工件的磨损。这些液体通常通过简单的混合水和矿物油、脂肪油、植物油以及乳化剂的过程来生产。

common:generalComment.#text: Calcium hydroxide, also called slaked lime or hydrated lime, is a soft white powder widely used as a raw material in the chemical industry. It forms when calcium oxide is mixed with water. The compound has two hydroxide ions for each ion of calcium. The chemical is ionic, with aqueous and electrolytic dissociations both producing calcium ions and hydroxide ions. It is an inorganic compound which has a white, powdery appearance in its solid-state. However, in its crystalline form, it has a colorless appearance.

common:generalComment.#text: Urea (urea), also known as urea, carbamide, chemical formula is CH4N2O or CO(NH2)2, is an organic compound composed of carbon, nitrogen, oxygen, hydrogen, is a white crystal. One of the simplest organic compounds, it is the main nitrogenous end product of protein metabolic breakdown in mammals and certain fish.As a neutral fertilizer, urea is suitable for a variety of soils and plants. It is easy to preserve, easy to use, small damage to the soil, is a large use of a chemical nitrogen fertilizer, but also the highest nitrogen content. In industry, ammonia and carbon dioxide are used to synthesize urea under certain conditions.
尿素（urea）又称尿素、碳酰胺，化学式为 CH4N2O 或 CO(NH2)2，是一种由碳、氮、氧、氢组成的有机化合物，是一种白色晶体。作为一种中性肥料，尿素适用于各种土壤和植物。它易于保存，使用方便，对土壤破坏小，是使用量较大的一种化学氮肥，也是含氮量最高的一种肥料。在工业上，氨和二氧化碳在一定条件下合成尿素。

common:generalComment.#text: Adhesives are substances capable of holding materials together in a functional manner by surface attachment that resists separation. They are often used interchangeably with terms like cement, mucilage, glue, and paste. Adhesives can be used to hold, fasten, or bond two or more materials or objects together. Adhesive bonding solutions can join the internal or external components of a product.

Brass is an alloy of copper (Cu) and zinc (Zn), in proportions which can be varied to achieve different colours and mechanical, electrical, and chemical properties. It has excellent resistance to seawater corrosion and is easy to machine and form. It also has a biocidal effect which makes it excellent for antibacterial applications. The color of the material is typically golden-yellow, although it may exhibit a reddish color when the alloy contains elevated copper content, commonly referred to as 'red brass.'

common:generalComment.#text: Copper solder is a medium and high-temperature welding material based on copper, often with the addition of alloying elements such as zinc, silver, and nickel. It is used for high-strength, high-temperature resistant connections of metal parts and to form dense joints. The core component is copper, and the mainstream alloy systems include copper-zinc series (brass solder), copper-silver series, copper-nickel series, etc. They are suitable for connecting materials such as steel, copper alloys, and stainless steel, and are widely used in mechanical manufacturing, pipeline engineering, high-temperature equipment, and photovoltaic brackets/cable joints, among other scenarios.

common:generalComment.#text: A coating is a covering that is applied to the surface of an object, usually referred to as the substrate. The purpose of applying the coating may be decorative, functional, or both. Coatings may be applied as liquids, gases or solids. Paints and lacquers are coatings that mostly have dual uses of protecting the substrate and being decorative. A protective coating is a layer of material that is applied to a substrate to prevent it from being damaged by environmental factors such as corrosion, abrasion and weathering.

common:generalComment.#text: Polyurethane Synthetic Leather, also known as PU leather, is a synthetic material made by coating a fabric backing with a flexible polymer. It is completely artificial and considered vegan. It offers a soft and luxurious feel, resembling genuine leather. PU leather is highly durable, resistant to wear and tear, and easier to clean. It is commonly used in upholstery, furniture, and clothing.
聚氨酯合成皮革，也被称为PU皮革，是一种通过在织物背衬上涂覆柔韧聚合物制成的合成材料。它完全是人造的，被认为是纯素的。它提供了柔软和豪华的感觉，类似于真皮。PU皮革具有高耐久性，抗磨损，且更易清洁。它常用于室内装饰，家具和服装。

Currency unit group extended for EEIO and CEEIO monetary product flows. For version 03.01.000, the reference unit EUR is interpreted as EUR_2000. Year-labelled EUR units are expressed in EUR_2000 with Eurostat HICP annual average index, euro area all-items (prc_hicp_aind, unit=INX_A_AVG, coicop=CP00, geo=EA). Year-labelled USD and CNY units are expressed in EUR_2000 by deflating local currency to year-2000 value with World Bank WDI FP.CPI.TOTL and then applying the World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF 2000 annual average official exchange rate. These generic currency units do not encode sector-specific purchaser-price, producer-price, or IO price-index adjustments.

为 EEIO 和 CEEIO 货币产品流扩展的货币单位组。 在 03.01.000 版本中，参考单位 EUR 解释为 EUR_2000。 带年份的 EUR 单位使用 Eurostat 欧元区全部项目 HICP 年平均指数折算为 EUR_2000（prc_hicp_aind, unit=INX_A_AVG, coicop=CP00, geo=EA）。 带年份的 USD 和 CNY 单位先用 World Bank WDI FP.CPI.TOTL 将本币折回 2000 年价值，再用 World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF 2000 年官方年平均汇率折算为 EUR_2000。 这些通用货币单位不编码部门特定的购买者价格、生产者价格或投入产出价格指数调整。
